✅ browser-test happy-path 63.4s · $0.24

Agent opens browser and visits a page

Result: Sent the browser-task prompt to the QA-20261123-212926-knkt agent and verified its reply names the page title "Example Domain" with the live browser preview showing example.com.

Steps (5)
  1. Navigated to http://localhost:47891 — Gamut home loaded, and the "QA-20261123-212926-knkt" agent (Idle, Never active) was listed in the "Your Agents" sidebar.
  2. Clicked the QA-20261123-212926-knkt agent in the sidebar — agent page opened at /agents/qa-20261123-212926-knkt-1l92pld6ss with the message composer visible.
  3. Sent "Open a browser and go to https://example.com. Tell me the page title." — pressing Enter left the text in the composer unsent, so I clicked the Send button, and the message posted into a new session "Check Example.com Page Title" with the agent switching to "working".
  4. Waited up to 3 minutes for a response — the reply "The page title is "Example Domain"" appeared well within the window. The turn showed "Worked for 3s · 2 tool calls · 121,835 tokens" and the agent returned to idle.
  5. Verified the response mentions "Example Domain" and took a screenshot — confirmed. The screenshot shows the chat reply, and the browser preview panel on the right titled "Example Domain" at https://example.com/, with "Open Browser https://example.com" under Browser agent actions.
